# Literary Devices

> A comprehensive reference guide to literary devices, techniques, and terms used in writing and literary analysis.

Literary Devices provides detailed definitions, examples, and analysis of literary techniques across poetry, prose, and rhetoric. The site covers fundamental concepts like point of view and characterization alongside specialized devices like anaphora and zoomorphism, making it an essential resource for writers, students, and literary scholars.

## Key Topics

- Literary Devices
- Literary Terms
- Literary Analysis
- Writing Techniques
- Figure of Speech
- Poetry Techniques
- Rhetoric
- Literary Elements
- Characterization
- Point of View
- Tone
- Genre
- Narrative Structure
- Definition and Examples
- William Shakespeare

## Core References

- [Literary Devices - Literary Terms, Techniques, and Elements](https://literarydevices.com): Homepage with comprehensive list of literary devices, terms, and techniques with definitions and examples.
- [List of Literary Devices](https://literarydevices.com/list-of-literary-devices): Alphabetical index and reference list of literary devices for writing and analysis.

## Narrative and Character Devices

- [Point of View Examples and Definition](https://literarydevices.com/point-of-view): Definition and examples of point of view with literary analysis from classic works.
- [Characterization Examples and Definition](https://literarydevices.com/characterization): Definition and examples of characterization and character development techniques.
- [Foil Examples and Definition](https://literarydevices.com/foil): Definition and examples of foil characters in literature and character analysis.
- [Tone Examples and Definition](https://literarydevices.com/tone): Definition and examples of tone as a literary device and writing technique.
- [Genre Examples and Definition](https://literarydevices.com/genre): Definition and examples of literary genres and fiction classification systems.
- [Climax Examples and Definition](https://literarydevices.com/climax): Definition and examples of climax in narrative structure and dramatic arc.

## Rhetorical and Figurative Devices

- [Anaphora Examples and Definition](https://literarydevices.com/anaphora): Definition and examples of anaphora with famous speeches by historical figures.
- [Trope Examples and Definition](https://literarydevices.com/trope): Definition and examples of trope in figures of speech and literary analysis.
- [Asyndeton Examples and Definition](https://literarydevices.com/asyndeton): Definition and examples of asyndeton in rhetoric and writing techniques.
- [Meiosis Examples and Definition](https://literarydevices.com/meiosis): Definition and examples of meiosis as a figure of speech and understatement.
- [Zoomorphism Examples and Definition](https://literarydevices.com/zoomorphism): Definition and examples of zoomorphism in figurative language and literature.
- [Synesthesia Examples and Definition](https://literarydevices.com/synesthesia): Definition and examples of synesthesia as a figure of speech and sensory language.

## Poetry and Sound Devices

- [Assonance Examples and Definition](https://literarydevices.com/assonance): Definition and examples of assonance in poetry and vowel sound repetition.
- [Enjambment Examples and Definition](https://literarydevices.com/enjambment): Definition and examples of enjambment in poetry and verse structure.
- [Couplet Examples and Definition](https://literarydevices.com/couplet): Definition and examples of couplets in poetry forms and verse structure.
- [Inversion Examples and Definition](https://literarydevices.com/inversion): Definition and examples of inversion and anastrophe in syntax and poetry.

## Reference and Tools

- [Pleonasm Examples and Definition](https://literarydevices.com/pleonasm): Definition and examples of pleonasm, a redundant and tautological phrase.
- [Citation](https://literarydevices.com/citation): Citation guide for MLA, APA, Harvard, and Chicago/Turabian formats.
